Equality is possible only at h_i*=H(a_i+a_{i-1})/(2S); direct matrix multiplication and Perron positivity prove exact attainment as the simple maximum. N=3 trace identity gives squared-speed ratio 1:2. All quantifiers/boundaries and 13,200 finite supplementary checks verified.
